proposed_owner_row.rationale: One missing conditional source-operation coverage/applicability requirement: from an authentic selected descriptor, exact full effective argv and independently retained source dialect, distinguish represented synchronous body/control/lookup effects from registration result transitions and noncovered residual/observer obligations before retaining later source-only mapped diagnostic rows. Existing source effect/transition APIs transport conservative effects but do not certify this continuation facet. Extend those existing owners; do not create a competing resolver. Count once across per-operation cards, prefix transport and compiler adoption, not per trace/helper/caller.
open_boundaries: actual immutable descriptor/source availability and complete operand provenance
noncovered lookup/observer applicability residuals retained chronologically
later source rows retain current full input/configuration/declaration and genuinely conditional handler selection

counting_rules: Requirement is counted even if implementation is withheld or blocked.
No count per descriptor, release, callback, cache, helper, prefix type, or later mapped row.
No duplication of baseline2749 caller or already counted mapped-source owner.
No debt subtraction or ordinary lookup-stability grant follows from this count recommendation.
